title: •Jeroen Webb
caption: •Jeroen Webb (V)
game_text: If deploying to opponent’s mobile site, deploys -2 as an Undercover spy. Nevar Yalnal may not target spies here. Opponent’s total influence here is -1 for each of your spies at sites.
lore: Native of Ralltiir. Spy for Ralltiir’s underground network after his homeworld was subjugated.

notes: Unique. ODD STAT BOX: the slip's third box reads 'ARMOR 4' (a value, not a label) on a Rebel character — stats [POWER 1, ABILITY 2, ARMOR 4]; the printed card's third box is empty. Deploy 2 / forfeit 4 (as printed); the wiki stub has deploy=4 and no forfeit (differs). Icon column: pilot (yellow LS helmet), as printed. No margin credits. Curly apostrophes in opponent’s / Opponent’s. Base page: the default 'Jeroen Webb' carries Glossary 2.0 errata text, so 'Jeroen Webb (Original)' (printed face, same lore/destiny/set) is used. The 745 px Hoth-L-jeroenwebb.gif is a D-E1 errata face ('anything he pilots'; prints 'Spy' bold in the lore) — downloaded to src/vs12/14-Hoth-L-jeroenwebb.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src (bold not discernible there, so not marked). Lore corrected: curly apostrophe in Ralltiir’s (wiki straight). Copyright 1996 (Hoth) legible on the 745 px face. Modern: VB2-L-jeroenwebb-pre.gif (350 px); no V<N> remake.
